description:

Year: 2024

Collection piece: 1 of 30
Signed by: Mitchell Bernal and Mike Mignola

title: Hellboy — Comic Book Series 1 (Closed Mouth)
description:
A comic-inspired action figure that translates Mignola's angular character design into a poseable collectible. This version has Hellboy's calmer, closed-mouth expression.

Release: 2005
Series: Hellboy Comic Book Series 1

Height: 19.4 cm (approximately 7.6 in)

description:

Publisher: IDW Publishing
Release: July 23, 2014
Edition: Signed, Numbered and Remarqued

Artist: Mike Mignola
Editor: Scott Dunbier
Format: Oversized hardcover
Pages: 202
Dimensions: 12 × 17 inches
ISBN: 978-1-63140-003-2

Performer: Ron Perlman
Type: Screen-worn hero dental prosthetics
Original case: Red case labelled “RON PERLMAN HELLBOY #2”

title: Hellboy — Ron Perlman Left Hand Rubber Fingers
description:

title: Hellboy Black & White — Richard Corben Integral
description: A collected volume of Richard Corben’s Hellboy work, presented in black and white. The collection’s Facebook caption identifies this copy as number 007 of 930 and describes a 320-page volume.

title: Hellboy II — Iron Studios Art Scale 1:10
description: An Iron Studios Hellboy statue in the Art Scale 1:10 line, inspired by Hellboy II. The original collection post records its arrival alongside the museum’s other Iron Studios pieces.

title: Liz Sherman — Mezco Hellboy Comic Book Series
description: Liz Sherman joins the museum’s Mezco Hellboy Comic Book Series collection. This figure represents the character through the comic-inspired line identified in the original collection caption.

title: Hellboy (2019) — Korean Lenticular Full Slip Type B1
description: A limited-edition Korean Blu-ray release of Hellboy (2019), presented in a Type B1 lenticular full-slip case. The original caption also identifies cards and a book among the accompanying materials.

title: Lobster Johnson — Mezco Hellboy Comic Book Series
description: Lobster Johnson is represented in the museum by this Mezco Hellboy Comic Book Series figure. The original collection post identifies both the character and the figure line.

title: Hellboy — H. P. Lovecraft Film Festival & CthulhuCon 2008 Poster
description: A Hellboy poster associated with the 2008 H. P. Lovecraft Film Festival & CthulhuCon. The museum’s original caption credits Mike Mignola.

title: Hellboy II — EverythingBlu BluPack #006 SteelBook
description: Hellboy II: The Golden Army in the EverythingBlu Exclusive BluPack #006 edition, combining 4K UHD and Blu-ray in a SteelBook presentation. The original collection caption states a limited run of 850.

title: Abe Sapien — Mezco 2007 Comic-Con Exclusive
description: Abe Sapien from Mezco’s Hellboy Comic Book Series, identified in the original museum post as a 2007 Comic-Con exclusive action figure.
